zh-Hant.tagline: 分享一杯，遇見同好 · AI 更懂你的口味
zh-Hant.title: 嗨飲 hi drink — 每一杯，都是一個故事
zh-Hant.description: 嗨飲 hi drink：拍照發帖，記下每一杯的故事；和駐場酒保 Ivy 聊天、玩大話骰，找到同好。
zh-Hant.screenshotNote: 畫面依實際功能設計 · 示範內容
zh-Hant.responsible: 18+ · 理性飲酒，切勿酒後駕駛 · AI 回答僅供參考

hero.title: 每一杯，
hero.sub:
拍下今晚，碰杯、玩一局，分享更好玩。
Ivy 越聊越懂你，口味相投的人也越走越近。

end.title: 從第一杯，
end.sub: 拍照發帖、和 Ivy 玩一局、約人同飲、回放足跡。今晚，從一聲「嗨」開始。

capture.title: 眼前這一杯，
capture.sub:
拍下的每一刻，都會收進你的足跡。
在「分享今晚」即拍或選圖，選「帖子」就永久保留。
capture.detail: 即拍或相簿選圖 · 帖子永久保留

edit.title: 調好光影，
edit.sub:
濾鏡、調整、裁切，讓照片貼近當下的氣氛。
加上文字和地點，酒類標籤還會記下你的口味。
edit.detail: 濾鏡 · 調整 · 裁切 · 文字 · 酒類標籤 · 地點

map.title: 一張照片，
map.sub:
帖子出現在你喝酒的地方，也收進你的足跡。
酒友打開詳情，可以碰杯、點讚或留言。
map.detail: 地圖上的帖子 · 帖子詳情 · 碰杯與留言

ivy.title: 推開酒吧的門，
ivy.sub:
Ivy 是陪你喝一杯的 AI，懂你的口味，聊聊今晚喝什麼。
想玩就開一局大話骰或 21 點，贏了再多 3 次聊天。
ivy.detail: 和 Ivy 聊天 · 大話骰 · 21 點

dice.eyebrow: 大話骰 / 和 IVY 對決
dice.title: 搖骰，偷看，
dice.sub:
骰子蓋在骰盅下，按住偷看，只有你看得到。
按住說話就能叫骰，看穿 Ivy 就開盅。
dice.detail: 按住說話，叫骰　／　按住偷看　／　開盅

cocktail.eyebrow: 整一杯 / 跟著酒譜做
cocktail.title: 選一份酒譜，
cocktail.sub:
手邊有材料，就能調出一杯像樣的。
配圖一步步帶你做，完成後拍照發帖。
cocktail.detail: 選酒譜 → 看配方 → 跟著做 → 拍照分享
cocktail.focus: 每一步都有配圖和 Ivy 提示

party.title: 今晚有局，
party.sub:
不想一個人喝？看看今晚有哪些局，只約認證酒吧。
時間、地點、發起人和席位一目了然，開局前可隨時退出。
party.detail: 探索 → 酒局詳情 → 參加酒局

trail.title: 走過的每一站，
trail.sub:
還記得那一晚去過哪幾站嗎？按日期翻看照片和地點。
再打開足跡地圖，腳印沿路回放，可暫停、換站、調速度。
trail.detail: 按日期回看 → 照片記錄 → 地圖預覽 → 腳印回放
trail.focus: 站點、腳印路徑與播放控制

meet.title: 用一句話，
meet.sub:
找酒友、酒吧、酒局或帖子，打字或語音都可以。
AI 先列出理解的條件，再說明每個結果為何適合你。
meet.detail: 說出需求 → 確認條件 → 查看結果

tonight.eyebrow: 今晚喝什麼 / 給你靈感
tonight.title: 還沒決定？
tonight.sub:
揭曉今晚的酒類，不滿意就再抽一次。
接著找附近酒吧及便利店，或約人同飲。
tonight.detail: 抽選 → 揭曉 → 去附近／約人同飲

cheers.title: 喜歡這張照片？
cheers.sub:
在帖子上向對方碰杯，比留言更輕鬆。
收到與送出的碰杯都有記錄，可以回敬，也可以直接聊天。
cheers.detail: 碰杯 → 收到回應 → 回敬／聊天

home.title: 從地圖出發，
home.sub:
地圖連起附近的帖子、約局和今晚的靈感。
個人主頁收好你的打卡、足跡、收藏和口味卡。
home.detail: 主地圖 → 個人主頁 → 打卡／足跡／收藏

browse.paused: 已暫停 · 按播放繼續

en.tagline: Share a drink. Find your people. AI knows your taste.
en.title: hi drink — Every drink tells a story
en.description: hi drink: share every drink in photo posts. Chat and play Liar’s Dice with Ivy, the resident bartender, and find your people.
en.screenshotNote: Based on real app features · Demo content
en.responsible: 18+ · Enjoy responsibly. Never drink and drive. · AI replies are for reference only

hero.title: Every drink
hero.sub:
Snap the night, send a cheers, play a round.
Ivy learns your taste. People who share it get closer.

end.title: From the first drink
end.sub: Post your night, play a round with Ivy, meet up and replay your trail. Tonight starts with a hi.

capture.title: A night worth a photo.
capture.sub:
Every moment you capture joins your trail.
Shoot or pick one in Share tonight. Post keeps it for good.
capture.detail: Camera or library · Posts are kept for good

edit.title: Get the look right.
edit.sub:
Filter, adjust and crop until it feels like the moment.
Add words and a place. Drink tags help build your taste profile.
edit.detail: Filter · Adjust · Crop · Text · Drink tags · Place

map.title: One photo.
map.sub:
Your post appears where the night happened and joins your trail.
Others can open it to send a cheers, like or comment.
map.detail: Posts on the map · Post details · Cheers and comments
map.focus: Open a post from the map

ivy.title: Push open the door.
ivy.sub:
Ivy is an AI who keeps you company and gets your taste.
Up for a game? Beat her at Liar’s Dice or Blackjack to win 3 more chats.
ivy.detail: Chat with Ivy · Liar’s Dice · Blackjack
ivy.focus: Start a game right at the bar

dice.title: Shake. Peek.
dice.sub:
Dice stay under the cup. Hold to peek, and only you can see them.
Hold to speak your bid, or call it if you think Ivy is bluffing.
dice.detail: Hold to speak your bid · Hold to peek · Call it

cocktail.eyebrow: MIX A DRINK / FOLLOW A RECIPE
cocktail.title: Pick a recipe.
cocktail.sub:
Got the ingredients? You can mix a proper drink.
Illustrated steps walk you through it, then post a photo.
cocktail.detail: Choose → Check the recipe → Follow along → Share

party.title: Meetups tonight.
party.sub:
Don’t want to drink alone? See tonight’s meetups, at verified bars only.
Time, place, host and seats at a glance. Leave any time before it starts.

trail.title: Every stop you made,
trail.sub:
Remember where that night took you? Browse photos and places by date.
Replay the footprints on your trail map. Pause, skip or speed up.
trail.detail: Pick a date → Photos → Map preview → Footprint replay

meet.title: Say what you’re after.
meet.sub:
Look for people, bars, meetups or posts by typing or speaking.
See how your request was understood, and why each result fits.
meet.detail: Describe → Check the criteria → See results
meet.focus: Match score and why it fits

tonight.title: Can’t decide?
tonight.sub:
Reveal tonight’s drink, or draw again.
Then find nearby bars and shops, or invite friends.
tonight.detail: Draw → Reveal → Go nearby or invite
tonight.focus: Your next step, right after the draw

cheers.title: Like the photo?
cheers.sub:
Send a cheers on a post. It’s lighter than a comment.
See cheers received and sent, cheers back or start a chat.
cheers.detail: Cheers a post → Get a reply → Cheers back or chat
cheers.focus: Received, sent and cheers both ways

home.title: Start on the map.
home.sub:
The map brings posts, meetups and nearby places together.
Your profile keeps your check-ins, trail, saved places and taste card.
home.detail: Home map → Your profile → Check-ins, trail, saved
